readout_other: MCELP-CS; Autism Behavior Checklist; fNIRS resting-state connectivity (Hitachi ETG-4100)
direction_notes: Single case: language scores improved and ABC scores fell after 4 weeks, sustained at follow-up; fNIRS connectivity increased in some prefrontal pairs and decreased in others. The amygdala protocol was labelled inhibitory and the STSva protocol excitatory by the authors, but this was not tested.
safety_notes: Real-time observation each session plus 10 min post-session monitoring; no headache, skin irritation or behavioural deterioration reported. Parameters kept within FDA limits per BabelBrain planning.

timing.protocol_description: PRF 40 Hz, DC 1.6%, pulse train duration 400 ms, single pulse 0.4 ms, pulse repetition interval 25 ms, 30 min per session; delivered first, then the STSva; daily Monday to Friday for 4 weeks.
PRF 200 Hz, DC 6%, pulse train duration 1000 ms, single pulse 0.3 ms, pulse repetition interval 5 ms, 20 min per session; delivered after the amygdala; daily Monday to Friday for 4 weeks.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Case Presentation: An 11-year-old minimally verbal ASD boy received 4 weeks of sequential tFUS stimulation (0.5 MHz).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The treatment is performed daily (Monday to Friday) and lasts for 4 weeks (a total of 20 treatment sessions) with 100% adherence.
